**Finding submitted: deviation (ASSIGN), preferred-level cure.**

- **Responsive locations checked:** paragraph (h) (p0072) is the sole assignment clause; searches for "change of control", "merger/successor", and the termination provisions (p0016) confirmed no change-of-control termination or re-pricing trigger, so the walk-away scenario and the preferred no-CoC-termination element are already satisfied.
- **What fails:** the no-consent carve-out for affiliates, asset purchasers and merger successors runs to *both* parties, so Kubient can assign free of our consent (and to a competitor). That mutual exception also defeats the fallback requirement that all non-successor assignments require consent, so the clause fails both levels.
- **Cure (one surgical replace):** the carve-out becomes Customer-only and adds a bar on Kubient assigning to a competitor of Customer; the "not unreasonably withheld" consent standard, the void-assignment sentence and all unrelated text in (h) are preserved verbatim.
